svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Technical implementation on Azure: PCI/PII document redaction
Which Azure service does what, from the first request to the masked JSON response. File bytes go straight to Blob Storage, never through API Management.
Logic exists in languageservice.py today; the rest is the target design
Front door for every API call
Declared size ≤ 500 MB and allowed type: early reject
Calls Functions with its managed identity
Logs metadata only, never request bodies
One JSON blob per job: status,
Malicious file: reject job, delete blob
Size ≤ 500 MB, read from blob properties
Real type from first bytes, not the extension
Pages ≤ 2,000, counted inside the file (PDF page list, TIFF frames)
Page count: 500 pages 25 ms, 2,000 pages 99 ms
Pass: enqueue job. Fail: job rejected, blob deleted
Container Apps: redaction worker (languageservice.py) · fails closed: any error, no output
5 docs and 1 MB per request; S0:
Fail if a card number or CVV
Block mode: card data found, no
Rate limit and quota per client
Declared size ≤ 500 MB and file type
Early reject only: the client declares it
Intake Function (8): first bytes of the file
Intake Function (8): counted inside the file
Backstop: rejects files over its limits
Job-status Function (12): oid in job record
API Management can't count pages: the file never reaches it,
and its content validation only inspects small bodies.
CROSS-CUTTING CONTROLS · every component above is in PCI DSS scope
Issues callers' tokens; API Management validates them.
Key auth is disabled on the AI services
API Management, Functions, and worker reach Storage,
Service Bus, and AI services without keys
Only for secrets that can't use an identity, such as
Storage, Service Bus, Document Intelligence, Language,
Functions and worker are VNet-integrated; public access
Request metadata, timings, and errors; never request
Diagnostic logs from every resource; no document content
Security posture and threat alerts across all resources
